project_info.theme: Serious glance on a rainy city street at night
project_info.color_palette: warm gold, wet asphalt black, cool atmospheric blue, muted charcoal

main_subject.detail: An adult man with wavy blonde hair looks over his shoulder with a serious expression while standing on a crowded rainy city street at night.

items: shoulder-turn portrait with sharp focus on the face
crowded rain-soaked city street behind him
traffic and city lights form intense warm golden bokeh
rain droplets and glowing dust particles caught in light
cool blue upper atmosphere contrasts with warm street-level glow

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: moody night-city lighting with warm traffic glow and cool atmospheric blue
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: shimmering rain and golden particles create luminous depth around the sharply focused subject

technical_specs.render_style: photorealistic 35mm portrait with shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: warm golden bokeh against cool blue atmosphere, cinematic contrast, natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-definition cinematic portrait of an adult man with wavy blonde hair looking over his shoulder with a serious expression. He stands on a crowded rainy city street at night. Fill the background with intense warm golden bokeh from city lights and traffic, contrasting with cool blue tones in the upper atmosphere. Catch rain droplets and glowing golden dust particles in the light to create a shimmering ethereal atmosphere. Keep sharp focus on his face and use shallow depth of field, photorealistic 35mm photography, natural skin texture, and moody cinematic lighting.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve wavy blonde hair, shoulder glance, rainy crowd, golden bokeh, cool blue atmosphere, and 35mm mood. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-reference
assets.usage: Maintain adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the original shoulder glance, rainy city, golden bokeh, and cinematic lighting.
